ideas.name: Cross-exchange funding-rate forecast spread (Binance/Bybit)
ideas.claim: Forecast funding rates with double autoregressive models; short the contract with higher expected funding and buy the other exchange's contract to capture the funding difference.
ideas.quote: It shorts the contract with the higher expected funding rate and buys the contract on the other exchange.

rules.market: BTC perpetuals on Binance and Bybit
rules.timeframe: funding intervals; backtest about four months
rules.entry: short higher expected funding contract, long the other exchange's contract

ideas.claimed_result: Annualized 6.258% (DAR) vs 4.258% (benchmark) with modeled fees; 10.122% vs 16.652% with no fees (secondary summary of Inan, Int. Rev. Financial Analysis)
required_data: Binance and Bybit funding rate history
